sections.body: Cảm ơn, tôi hiểu rồi answers the traveler question "Thanks, I understand now" in finding places, turns, distance, and walking directions. sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: In Directions & Navigation, locals often answer with a clear reply, a pointed detail, or a simple follow-up rather than a long explanation. sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If the answer is long, ask them to point or type it. Street directions can be hard to catch by ear.

sections.title: Local tip
sections.body: Show the map or address first, then ask the phrase. The answer is easier to understand when both of you see the same place.
